stories.originalTitle: Google opens Android development to third-party AI agents and unveils new Gemini APIs
stories.summary: Google is opening up Android Studio to third-party AI agents. Through a new "Bring Your Own Agent" feature, the IDE now supports more than 40 coding agents, including Anthropic's Claude Agent and OpenAI's Codex. Google says new terminal tools also help agents
points: Google is opening up Android Studio to third-party AI agents.
Through a new "Bring Your Own Agent" feature, the IDE now supports more than 40 coding agents, including Anthropic's Claude Agent and OpenAI's Codex.
Google says new terminal tools also help agents finish UI tasks 77 percent faster while using up to three times fewer tokens.

stories.title: Quoting Ted Sanders
stories.summary: In general, LLM performance is incredibly multidimensional. There's no guarantee of a fixed ordering where the model that is best at math is also the model that's best at jokes. Despite that complexity, much of the variation in performance is explained by just
points: In general, LLM performance is incredibly multidimensional.
There's no guarantee of a fixed ordering where the model that is best at math is also the model that's best at jokes.
Despite that complexity, much of the variation in performance is explained by just a single variable: model size.
